item.title: Landmark ancient-genome study shows surprise acceleration of human evolution
item.description:
📝 Credit: Denis-Art/GettyThe biggest ever study of ancient human DNA shows that human evolution has accelerated over the past 10,000 years. They then discounted changes that could be explained by forces other than selection, identifying 479 variants that showed strong signs of directional selection. The latest study suggests that the variant has become less common in some European groups in the past 2,000 years.
